findings.pdf_says: The level-2 box that encloses general rules (14) through (18) continues unbroken down the page and also encloses "(19) The END-UNSTRING phrase delimits the scope of the UNSTRING statement. (See page IV-40, Scope of Statements.)" and "(20) If, at the time of execution of an UNSTRING statement, the conditions described in general rule 17 are not encountered, ..."; the box closes only after "UNSTRING statement." at the end of rule (20).
findings.markdown_says:
(19) The END-UNSTRING phrase delimits the scope of the UNSTRING statement. (See page IV-40, Scope of Statements.)

(20) If, at the time of execution of an UNSTRING statement, the conditions described in general rule 17 are not encountered, ...
findings.why_it_matters: The box marks level-2 (high level) specifications. Rules (19) and (20) carry no box markers, so the END-UNSTRING and NOT ON OVERFLOW rules read as level 1, while rules (14)-(18) beside them on the same page keep their markers.
